title: Godot stops working properly, after interacting with specific elements of the Editor
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in:
- v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
- v4.2.stable.official [46dc27791]
- v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]
- v4.0.beta17.official [c40020513]
- v4.0.beta10.official [d0398f62f]
- v4.0.beta5.official [89a33d28f]

Reproduced in -> if using these versions for testing the bug in the Project-Manager, then you need furthermore to maximize the window (after following the other described steps to reproduce):
- v4.0.beta4.official [e6751549c]
- v4.0.beta3.official [01ae26d31]
- v4.0.beta1.official [20d667284]
- v4.0.alpha17.official [22a09fef5]
- v4.0.alpha1.official [31a7ddbf8]

Not Reproduced in:
- v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]
- v3.0.stable.official

### System information

Windows 11 Home 24H2 - Intel(R) Core™ i7-14700HX 2.10 GHz - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop -  16,0 GB RAM

### Issue description

The screen freezes visually after interacting with specific elements of the editor:

Interaction-locations:
- The copy button of the current using version in the Project-Manager
- The file-system-manager in your project
- The scene-manager in your project

The effects are (as I could infer), that visually nothing is working (that is probably why for example the editor in the video scales so badly after reproducing the bug → as you can see, the bug disappeares after I open the project). However in theory, Godot is still working, kind of, as I could for example still open my project after reproducing the bug. After closing the program, because of my random clicking, I also changed sometimes my code in the script slitely.

-> this issue is originally from the Godot Forum ("Godot stops working properly, after interacting with specific elements of the Editor")

### Steps to reproduce

Here a video of the bug: https://1drv.ms/v/c/5a5b21375e59fb03/ESg6Advc4LpHmKyL2gXiNH4BPKHZhaaAHQiLkvMR_PZYRw?e=bHNpyH

Explanation of the video:
- opening Godot
- showing that everything workes as intended in the Project-Manager
- clicking on the copy button for the current version a few times and waiting for 5sec.
- showing that I can`t preselect (visually) my projects anymore
- showing that the scaling does not work how intended
- opening a project
- showing that interacting with the script workes as intended
- clicking on some files in the file-system-manager and waiting for 5sec.
- showing that interacting with the script doesn`t work as intended

Reproduce by yourself:
- Copy button: open Project-Manager; click on button; wait for 5sec.(; if needed, maximize the window -> see tested versions); try to change your window-size or hovering on your projects -> visuals won't work
- File-system-/scene-manager: open a new project; click on files or on the arrow beside the files/click on nodes; wait for 5 sec. (; if you use Forward+ then you sometimes need to make you window smaller); try to change your window-size or editing your script -> visuals won't work

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

for copy button: you don't need anything (as it is in the project manager)

for file-system-manager: add 2 times a subfolder (interact with the arrow beside the subfolder above)
